cooked: Thanks for taking a look. There is already a -r option that only takes dice roles, so it can give “reproducable” results, ie. same dice rolls after sha256 hash always give same seed words. I compare with the results from iancolman.io/bip39 in the known_answer_100_rolls_no_os_entropy unit test.

raw: Thanks for taking a look. There is already a `-r` option that only takes dice roles, so it can give "reproducable" results, ie. same dice rolls after sha256 hash always give same seed words.
